//: Shared base for the per-package tsconfig.test.json files. It extends tsconfig.base.json — the same base every package's tsconfig.json extends — so test, demo and config files are checked under exactly the strictness src gets (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, verbatimModuleSyntax). Only the emit settings differ: these projects exist to report errors, not to produce output, and composite/declaration are incompatible with that.
